description: A skin condition characterised by velvety, thickened darkening of flexural skin, often associated with an underlying metabolic or hormonal disorder.
causes: Insulin resistance and associated metabolic or hormonal conditions
Less commonly certain medications or internal malignancy

appearance.general: Velvety papillomatous thickening and darkening, especially on the neck, axillae, groin, and other skin folds.

warning_signs: Abrupt widespread onset, especially without obesity or another obvious metabolic explanation, should prompt medical assessment.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss metabolic risk factors, weight changes, medications, and whether blood-glucose or other evaluation is appropriate.
